---
title: "Publications"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, results = "asis", message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
```

Journal articles, working papers, and official World Bank reports, refreshed weekly from
[ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3039-2004), [OpenAlex](https://openalex.org), and
Brian's [World Bank staff profile](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/people/b/brian-william-stacy).
Sorted by publication date, most recent first.

```{r}
pubs <- read_csv("data/publications_auto.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    title,
    sort_date = as.Date(glue("{year}-01-01")),
    kind = "Journal Article",
    venue,
    meta = glue(
      "{ifelse(is.na(coauthors) | coauthors == '', '', paste0('Authored with ', coauthors, '. '))}",
      "Cited by {cited_by_count} (OpenAlex)."
    ),
    link
  )

reports <- read_csv("data/wb_reports_auto.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(
    title,
    sort_date = date,
    kind = "WB Report",
    venue = type,
    meta = "",
    link = url
  )

all_pubs <- bind_rows(pubs, reports) %>%
  arrange(desc(sort_date))

# Manually-maintained GitHub repo links for a handful of publications - kept
# in a separate file (not touched by the fetch scripts) so they survive the
# weekly auto-refresh of publications_auto.csv/wb_reports_auto.csv. Joined by
# normalized title since punctuation/casing can differ slightly from source.
norm_title <- function(x) x %>% str_to_lower() %>% str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9 ]", " ") %>% str_squish()

repo_links <- read_csv("data/publication_repos.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(norm_title = norm_title(title), github_url)

all_pubs <- all_pubs %>%
  mutate(norm_title = norm_title(title)) %>%
  left_join(repo_links, by = "norm_title") %>%
  select(-norm_title)

all_pubs %>%
  mutate(
    year = format(sort_date, "%Y"),
    link_md = ifelse(is.na(link), "", glue("[View]({link})")),
    code_md = ifelse(is.na(github_url), "", glue("[Code]({github_url})")),
    meta_line = str_trim(glue("{meta} {link_md} {code_md}"))
  ) %>%
  glue_data(
    "<div class='entry'>\n\n",
    "**{title}** ({year}) <span class='kind'>{kind}</span>\n\n",
    "<span class='venue'>{venue}</span>\n\n",
    "<span class='meta'>{meta_line}</span>\n\n",
    "</div>\n"
  ) %>%
  paste(collapse = "\n") %>%
  cat()
```
